WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq IN (1222,1222+1,1222+2,1222+3,1222+4,1222+5,1222+6,1222+7,1222+8,1222+9,1222+10,1222+11)
), filtered_items AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE ((i_category IN ('Books','Children','Electronics')
            AND i_class IN ('personal','portable','reference','self-help')
            AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14','scholaramalgamalg #7','exportiunivamalg #9','scholaramalgamalg #9'))
           OR (i_category IN ('Women','Music','Men')
               AND i_class IN ('accessories','classical','fragrances','pants')
               AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1','edu packscholar #1','exportiimporto #1','importoamalg #1')))
), monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT fi.i_manager_id,
           SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales
    FROM store AS st
    JOIN store_sales AS ss
      ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    JOIN date_range AS dr
      ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_items AS fi
      ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY fi.i_manager_id, dr.d_moy
), monthly_stats AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id,
           sum_sales,
           AVG(sum_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY i_manager_id) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM monthly_sales
), ratio_stats AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id,
           sum_sales,
           avg_monthly_sales,
           CASE WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0
                THEN ABS(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / avg_monthly_sales
                ELSE NULL
           END AS sales_ratio
    FROM monthly_stats
)
SELECT i_manager_id,
       sum_sales,
       avg_monthly_sales
FROM ratio_stats
WHERE sales_ratio > 0.1
ORDER BY i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales
LIMIT 100
